scripts.build: bun run --cwd backend build && bun run --cwd frontend build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd backend typecheck && bun run --cwd frontend typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run lint:arrows && bun run --cwd backend lint && bun run --cwd frontend lint
scripts.dev:voice: uv run --project voice uvicorn --app-dir voice server:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8900
